designNotes: Use case per configurable area named in the criterion: permissions, approval thresholds, price tiers, timers, session status rules.
Each case checks the change takes effect without a deployment and that only Admin can make it (Configuration: Admin only).

cases.title: Granting a permission on screen takes effect at the next request

steps.action: As Admin, add lead.export to a custom role on the Roles screen and save
steps.expected: The role shows lead.export as granted

steps.action: As a user of that role, reload the leads list
steps.expected: The "Xuất Excel" button is shown without any deployment

testConditions: Role without lead.export -> granted -> export available

cases.title: Changing a role's discount threshold changes who approves

steps.action: As Admin, set the Fitness Manager discount threshold from 10% to 15%
Submit a contract with a 12% discount
steps.expected: The approval request goes to the Fitness Manager, not to Admin

testConditions: Fitness Manager threshold 10% -> 15%: a 12% discount moves from Admin to Fitness Manager

cases.title: A new price tier version applies to contracts created after it

steps.action: As Admin, change the PT tier unit price for 1-10 sessions and save
steps.expected: The tier list shows the new unit price

steps.action: Open a new PT contract for 10 sessions
steps.expected: The unit price on the form equals the new tier price

testConditions: Tier unit price changed by Admin

cases.title: Only Admin can change configuration

steps.action: As Fitness Manager, open the system parameters screen
steps.expected: The screen is refused; no parameter can be saved

testConditions: Configuration: Admin granted, Fitness Manager refused
